result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signals, but suffers from poor maintenance and design. Faded crosswalk markings and vehicles parked close to the intersection create visibility hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, making it less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A white car is parked very close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection using paint or bollards to ensure clear sightlines for all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic sidewalk infrastructure and curb ramps but lacks essential safety markings like crosswalks. The roadway is in poor condition with visible cracking, and parked vehicles near the corner create potential sightline obstructions for those attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings are visible to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and degraded, which can cause tripping hazards or unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the corner obstruct the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corner to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps with detectable warnings, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of vertical elements like street trees or a median create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians in a mixed-use industrial area.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: The absence of street trees or parked cars leaves pedestrians feeling exposed to adjacent traffic on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by extending the sidewalk at the corners.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer, reduce the heat island effect, and naturally calm traffic.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Wide corner radii
hazards.description: The geometry of the corners allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the road, which also helps calm traffic.
